query.esql:
FROM logs-ovh_managed_kubernetes.audit-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Total Events` = COUNT(*), `Failure Count` = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure" BY `Time Bucket` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `Failure Rate %` = ROUND(`Failure Count` / `Total Events` * 100, 2)
| SORT `Time Bucket`

FROM logs-ovh_managed_kubernetes.audit-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend

| EVAL `Failure Rate %` = ROUND(`Failure Count` / `Total Events` * 100, 2)
| SORT `Time Bucket`
